buyer_rank_pg: ledger_cover switch key reads the ledger back to the window's oldest paid seq

The 30 MB ledger tail left 605 window payments unknown on 11/09 (tail first seq 4193877, oldest paid seq 4052654).
With "ledger_cover": true the read doubles up to 400 MB; on the real ledger it stops at 60 MB (0.75 s) and the
outcomes equal a full read (payment_unknown 605 -> 2). Off by default; behaviour unchanged without the key.

I1 a sentence naming the warranty with a negation or an option, or a 0 h anywhere in the whole text, is not set aside
   ("No 72 h warranty", "optional", "available for +12%", "void", "보증 미적용"); the market's "if it breaks" and
   Korean product names are no hedge. 24 h replay: 5,759 -> 5,691 quotes read true, the 68 left are cut stored text.

   short_warranty_shops, so neither arm's 0 h history moves with arm B (the lower-bound claim is dropped).

I4 applied arm B receipts go to an O_APPEND 0600 event file; 4+ refused and over 25% sends later orders to arm A,
   recorded as tripped in the row and the log.
M1 off while buyer_goods_grade is on; M2 share < 1; M3 a reading that raises is false; M4 docstring sources;
M5 tests for the above and the 0 h receipt after a 6 h deal; M6 test_buyer_saved_floor reads with Path.read_text.

rank_pg ledger_cover streams once and is a recorded common boundary; warranty_said bw1-3 (review 2 I-a..I-c, m1-m6)

I-a _ledger_cover probes the first row's seq at each tail size and streams the ledger once (no list held).
I-c the cache is computed again when its ledger_cover differs from the switch (a failed compute caches the switch too);
    assignment rows carry ledger_cover: true; docstring and rank-integrity.md say it is a time boundary for all arms.
I-b the stop counts applied arm B orders that got a receipt (measure()), events carry the window's start_at (m5).
m1 rows keep the hash arm as assigned; m2 an arm B trade is held out of short_warranty_shops only inside its window;
m3 a duration under 6 h anywhere, waived, and the next sentence's hedge are not set aside; m4 cap0 is arm A's
short_cap; m6 measure() is the tested helper market_buyer calls. Replay: 5,770 -> 5,700 true, the 70 are cut text.
